title: Italian Sausage, Peppers and Onions with Sauce

ingredients.raw: 9 oz mixed color bell pepper, sliced into strips (about 2 large peppers)
1 tbsp olive oil (or more to taste)

instructions: Traditional Skillet Method: Grill sausages and slice into rounds. Alternately, slice sausages and cook in a large skillet over medium heat with 1 1/2 tsp oil, to brown (about 8-10 minutes). Remove sausage from the pan.
Traditional Skillet Method: While the sausage is cooking, slice the peppers and onion. Mince the garlic.

Traditional Skillet Method: Heat the oil over medium heat until it is hot. Swirl to coat the pan. Saute the vegetables with the garlic until softened (about 10 minutes). Add the sausage and any accumulated juices back to the pan to re-heat. Add the Marinara sauce and stir to coat. Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve.
Sheet Pan Method: Slice the sausage into rounds. Slice the peppers and onions. Mince the garlic.

Sheet Pan Method: Toss the ingredients with 1 tablespoon of oil and bake at 400 degrees F for 40 minutes until browned, stirring halfway through. Put into a bowl and add warmed Marinara sauce. Divide and serve.
